subject: general
question: In October 2024, which of the following companies was awarded the contract for design, manufacturing and commissioning of two high-speed trainsets by Integral Coach Factory (ICF) to be used in India’s first bullet train between Mumbai and Ahmedabad?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Earth Movers Limited (BEML)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **October 2024**, **BEML Limited** (formerly Bharat Earth Movers Limited) secured a major contract from the **Integral Coach Factory (ICF)**, Chennai, for the **design, manufacturing, and commissioning** of India’s first indigenous **high-speed trainsets**.
 
• The contract is valued at approximately **Rs. 866.87 crore** and marks a significant step toward the **Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail (MAHSR)** project, often referred to as the **Bullet Train** project.
 
• Under this agreement, **BEML** will produce **two high-speed trainsets**, each consisting of **8 cars**. These trains are designed to reach a **test speed of 280 kmph** and an **operational speed of 250 kmph**.
